notes: Hand-picked for a trip to the Azores (São Miguel, Terceira, Graciosa and the whale-watching boat trips). The Iberia trip holds the mainland birds; this pack adds the two Azores endemics (Azores Bullfinch of São Miguel's laurel forest and Azores Chaffinch), the Atlantic Canary, and the seabirds: Monteiro's and Band-rumped Storm-Petrels, Bulwer's Petrel, Cory's and Barolo Shearwaters, and the Roseate Tern colonies. Common Buzzard, Common Tern, Yellow-legged Gull, Grey Wagtail, Blackcap and Common Moorhen, which also live on the islands, are in the Iberia trip. The autumn American vagrants for which the Azores are famous are left out.
